newsitem.title: USA: Clinton abandons backing for CPI panel - report.
newsitem.headline: Clinton abandons backing for CPI panel - report.

text.p: President Clinton has abandoned the idea of establishing an independent panel to reduce the cost-of-living adjustments for Social Security and other federal benefits, the Washington Post reported Thursday.
The newspaper said the decision came after more than a week of unsuccessful efforts to build bipartisan support for it.

Quoting unidentified White House officials, the Post said Clinton was backing away from the idea because of overwhelming opposition from Democratic and Republican lawmakers who fear a public outcry if Washington scales back increases in popular federal benefit programs.
Clinton officials were seeking support for a panel to determine a more accurate cost-of-living gauge than the government's consumer price index (CPI), which many economists say overstates inflation.
